findings.title: Unescaped URL interpolated into HTML and stored raw
findings.body: The embed_url is interpolated directly into an HTML anchor (`#{url}`) and the contents are stored with cook_method raw_html, so the post body is rendered without sanitization. A feed item link containing a quote or markup (e.g. `'>

findings.title: Raw HTML from remote feeds/pages stored and rendered without sanitization
findings.body: Posts created by import use cook_method raw_html, so `Post#cook` returns the raw content unchanged. Content comes from remote RSS feeds or fetched third-party pages (import_remote uses Readability output, but PollFeed passes `i.content` directly). Script or event-handler markup from an untrusted source is rendered to all viewers of the topic and in the embed iframe, a stored XSS vector.

findings.title: open() of user-configured URL with Kernel#open allows command injection on old Rubies and no timeout
findings.body: `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` uses Kernel#open, which on Ruby versions before 3.0 treats strings starting with '|' as shell commands. The URL is an admin setting, but it also has no timeout, so a hung feed server blocks the scheduled job indefinitely. Use URI.open or a Net::HTTP call with timeouts.

findings.title: Kernel#open on a fetched URL in import_remote
findings.body: `open(url).read` is used on an URL that comes from embed requests (TopicRetriever passes the embed_url from an unauthenticated controller parameter, validated only by host). Kernel#open with a crafted string and no timeout can hang or execute commands on old Rubies, and the fetch has no size or time limit.

findings.title: Anonymous requests can enqueue unbounded retrieve jobs
findings.body: For any unknown embed_url, `best` enqueues a :retrieve_topic job for every request. The throttle is applied only inside the job (retrieved_recently? via redis), so a flood of distinct URLs on the embeddable host queues an unbounded number of jobs, each performing an outbound HTTP fetch.

findings.title: Referer check is spoofable and frame-embedding is allowed to all origins
findings.body: The embed endpoint authorizes access solely by the Referer header host, which is client controlled and may be stripped. Combined with `X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL` and the postMessage target built from request.referer in the layout, the content can be framed by anyone who sets the referer. The layout's postMessage with an unvalidated referer string also leaks the target origin.

findings.title: request.referer interpolated into JavaScript without escaping
findings.body: `'<%= request.referer %>'` is placed inside a script literal. ERB HTML-escapes but a referer containing a single quote or backslash-sequence is not JS-escaped, so the value can break out of the string literal in the inline script.

findings.title: Origin check uses substring indexOf, so it can be bypassed
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` checks whether the message origin is a substring of the forum URL, not equal to it. An origin such as 'http://a' or an empty/short string matches a substring of the forum URL and passes, letting other pages set the iframe height. The check should compare the origin for equality.

findings.title: Port handling drops explicit default ports inconsistently and prefix may be built on nil host
findings.body: `uri.host` is nil for URLs without a host, and the `prefix << ':port'` line mutates a string that may be frozen in some configurations. Also non-default ports on https (443 check only applies to one scheme) produce wrong absolute URLs for http on 443 or https on 80.

findings.title: contents mutated in place with <<
findings.body: `contents << ...` mutates the caller's string. In PollFeed, `content` is built once per item and reused; in TopicRetriever/import_remote the doc.content string is mutated, and the sha1 comparison on re-import now includes the footer added each time, so the footer is appended on every import call to the same string object.

findings.title: Throttle key set with setnx then expire is non-atomic
findings.body: setnx followed by a separate expire can leave the key without a TTL if the process dies between calls, permanently throttling that URL. Use SET with NX and EX in one command.

findings.title: user.try(:staff?) passes nil when no user, but args may be a Sidekiq hash with string keys
findings.body: Jobs are serialized through Sidekiq, so args keys become strings after serialization in some paths; `args[:user_id]` and `args[:embed_url]` may be nil, causing the InvalidParameters raise or silently skipping the user lookup.

findings.title: Disqus import no longer applies category option and removes the option entirely
findings.body: The --category option was deleted and the category handling removed, but the import now calls TopicEmbed.import_remote which fetches each thread's live URL instead of creating topics from the XML data. Imports now depend on network access to the old site and ignore the Disqus message content, a behavior change not reflected in the description or help text.

findings.title: raw_html posts skip the cooking pipeline and plugin filters entirely
findings.body: cook returns raw when cook_method is raw_html, bypassing Plugin::Filter :after_post_cook and all sanitization. Any post set to this method, including ones edited later, is stored unsanitized, and the before_save hook also calls cook so edits reuse raw content. Combined with the import path this is a security regression across the whole post model.

findings.title: Adding NOT NULL column with default rewrites entire posts table
findings.body: add_column with default and null: false on a large posts table locks and rewrites every row in PostgreSQL on older versions, blocking writes during deploy on large forums.

findings.title: Unique index on embed_url with no length guard for string column
findings.body: embed_url is a varchar with no length limit, and a unique btree index on long URLs can exceed PostgreSQL's index row size limit, causing inserts of long embed URLs to fail with an error that is not handled in TopicEmbed.import.

findings.title: force: true on create_table will drop existing top_topics data
findings.body: Adding force: true means that rerunning or running this migration on an installation where the table exists silently drops and recreates it, deleting all TopTopic rows without any warning.

findings.title: save with skip_validations silently ignores failures
findings.body: `@post.save(validate: ...)` return value is ignored, so a failed save (for example a validation error when skip_validations is false) leaves the in-memory post changed and save_reply_relationships still runs, and the caller receives true from revise!. Errors go unreported.

findings.title: embeddable_host and feed settings exposed without validation
findings.body: embeddable_host is an unvalidated string used as the sole referer check and also to decide which hosts to fetch from. No default validation or type constraint exists, so an admin mistake (e.g. a bare wildcard or empty string on a site that does not set it) can open the embed endpoint to any host.

findings.title: Success assertions run in an after hook and do not verify the behaviour under test
findings.body: The `after` block asserts response success and headers, but after blocks in the success context also run for the test that expects TopicRetriever and for the TopicView test where render behaviour differs. Failures are reported confusingly and the tests do not check that the loading template is rendered on the retrieve path.

findings.title: No test for security-relevant behavior: HTML injection through URL and raw content
findings.body: The spec asserts raw_html rendering but never tests that the embed URL is escaped in the footer or that script content is neutralized. The security regressions introduced by raw_html storage are unchecked.

findings.title: PollFeed item processing and error paths are untested
findings.body: Only the guard conditions and delegation are tested. poll_feed (parsing items, falling back to i.id, CGI unescaping, import) has no coverage, and the spec requires an unrelated process_post job file.
